Title: Gastroptosis - Wondered If It Was Just You Feeling Stuffed Fast?

Description:
If you have a thin frame and feel stuffed after just a few bites, three daily habits make gastroptosis worse: eating large meals too fast, slouching or lying down right after eating, and weak core muscles. Eat smaller meals more slowly, stay upright for 30 minutes after eating, and try gentle core exercises like a seated spinal twist to give your stomach more support.
